messages:
alex: Heads up — KB scan found a weird redirect that only fails in prod. Preview shows 200 but prod returns 404 for the SSH agent guide. Can someone triage? Not blocking but affects new-hire onboarding :eyes:
linkchecker-bot: crawl run 2025-10-12T14:03Z — anomaly detected for https://kb.redwood.com/kb/setup/ssh-agent?source=preview -> returns 200 in preview, 404 in https://kb.redwood.com/setup/ssh-agent in prod. Seen in 3 incoming checks.
mira: Do you have the exact file path? Might be a trailing slash / query param mismatch. Also could be CDN cache routing.
alex: File is content/kb/setup/ssh-agent.md in the monorepo. The published path should be /kb/setup/ssh-agent (no query). The preview link that passes includes ?source=preview which the server seems to accept.
sam: I can take this. Quick question: is the staging deploy config rewriting query params to the origin? If so we might need a redirect rule or remove the param from links.
charlie: Add to changelog? small UX hit, but ok to fix in a single PR.
mira: Quick repro: curl -I 'https://kb.redwood.com/kb/setup/ssh-agent?source=preview' -> 200
curl -I 'https://kb.redwood.com/kb/setup/ssh-agent' -> 404
Try grepping for the preview param in the content: 

```bash
rg "source=preview" -n content/kb || true
# replace occurrences if we want canonical links
sed -n '1s|source=preview||p' content/kb/setup/ssh-agent.md
```

If it's in a template include, fix there. If it's inline, do a targeted sed and open PR.
sam: Ok grabbing it. Will make branch docs/fix/ssh-agent-link-cleanup and push a PR with the sed patch + short note in changelog. Expect to open in ~45m. @alex can you verify the snippet after I push?
alex: Yep I will. Please add a line in the PR description about why prod returns 404 (CDN drop on unknown query).
charlie: tiny ask — add a test in kb-tests that validates canonical path responds 200 (so we catch regressions). Not necessary to block this PR, but a follow-up would be great.
sam: Will add a quick test in the same PR. Patch preview: 

```diff
- [SSH agent setup](https://kb.redwood.com/kb/setup/ssh-agent?source=preview)
+ [SSH agent setup](https://kb.redwood.com/kb/setup/ssh-agent)
```

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2387 — PTAL @alex @mira for CR, adding changelog entry and a small integration test.
alex: Reviewing now. :thumbsup:
linkchecker-bot: follow-up 2025-10-12T15:14Z — automated check passed for the canonical URL after merge (staging check 2025-10-12T15:30Z).
charlie: Thanks for the quick turn. Leaving note for ops to watch CDN cache TTLs in the next deploy window.
alex: Great. Closing loop — non-blocking infra note tracked in #eng-infra.
